svg.text: Dice on the map: one attack, replayed
Mara strikes the Goblin beside her. The engine has already decided everything; the screen replays its events. Cells are 34 dp.
Nothing travels, turns or flashes. Each event is one still, held 1.2 s by a timer: the die on the target, the number beside it, a 2.5 dp
foe outline on the target. The roll tray says the same in full. Haptics stay.
The roll tray: the whole sum, on screen until the next roll. A tap on it opens the log.
One flash per event. At most three flashes a second.
A tap on the map finishes every event in the queue.
Nothing loops. No button waits for an animation.
